title: Review, apply and refresh
description: Measure and apply a pending change, capture a new Baseline, then Parse all words and review the updated Text Coverage.

steps.measured: Review the measured change before applying it.
steps.applied: Apply records a Receipt and clears this pending change.
steps.refreshed: Refresh captures a new Baseline; Parse all words separately updates the numbers.
steps.parsed: The latest Assessment is published, with updated results in the Overview.
steps.timing: Timing shows the recorded parse measurements for the Selection.

measured.motif-apply-changes: Apply is available after measuring the change

refreshed.motif-freshness-detail: Refresh captured a Baseline; Parse all words is a separate action
